header_sentences: See Divine Itself; and see Only, and Self.

contexts.text: Each and all things relate to the very and Only existence.
Believe that faith is from themselves, and that good is from themselves.
The revelation from perception which the Lord had... was from the Divine in Himself, thus was from Himself.
The Lord (then) was peace to Himself...
When a Spirit man is in this state, he is in himself, and in his life itself; for to think freely from his Own affection is the life itself of man, and is Himself.
That the Divine love and wisdom are... the Very and Only Existence.

That is called the Itself which alone Is, and that the Only, from which is everything else. Now, as the Very and Only Existence is substance and form, it follows that it is the very and only substance and form; and as this substance and form itself is the Divine love and the Divine wisdom, it follows that it is the very and only love, and the very and only wisdom; consequently, that it is the very and only essence, and also the very and only life... TCR 53.
The general relation of all things is to Him.

Who is the Very and Only Existence from primes to ultimates, from which are all things; thus who is the very and only love, the very and only wisdom, and the very and only life in itself; and thus the very and only Creator, Saviour, and Enlightener from Himself... Signified. AR 38.
All these things in Him and from Him in them. Signified, Explained.
The Divine Esse is One, the Same, the Very Existence, Indivisible. Explained.

That the Divine Esse... is the Very Existence... God is the Very Existence, because He is love itself, wisdom itself, good itself, truth itself, life itself. Unless these were the Very Existence in God, they would not be anything in Heaven and the world, because there would not be anything of them relative to Him; for all quality is allotted its quality from that which is the Very Existence from which it is, and to which it has relation so as to become such as it is. This Very Existence, which is the Divine Esse, is not in place, but is with and in those who are in place, according to their reception; because of love and wisdom... which are the Very Existence in God, nay, God Himself, place cannot be predicated... Therefore the Lord says, that... He is in them, and they in Him.
The Very Existence, which is love itself and wisdom itself, was His soul from the Father, thus the Divine life... BE 119. TCR 25.
Saving faith is to believe in Him...
That God is the Very, the Only, and the First Existence, which is called Esse and Existere in itself, from which are all things which are and come forth...
That God is Love itself and Wisdom itself...
That God is Good itself and Truth itself...
That God... is Life itself, which is Life in Itself.
The interior will is the man himself...
The works done by the Lord in man, are done by the man as from himself...
They themselves are the head... But with those who love uses... they themselves are the soles...
